name: Flamecraft

categories.label: Reputation track at game end (before final bonuses)
categories.labelVi: Điểm Reputation trên track (trước thưởng cuối game)
categories.hint: Reputation gained during play from shops, enchantments, abilities and Sun Fancy Dragons.

categories.label: Leftover Coins
categories.hint: 1 Reputation per Coin returned to the Fountain; do this before scoring Fancy Dragons.

categories.label: Moon Fancy Dragons fulfilled
categories.hint: Sum the Reputation printed on each Moon Fancy Dragon whose goal you fulfilled (after Coins are returned). Sun Dragons already scored during play do not count again.

tiebreakers.description: Most Artisan Dragons left in hand
If still tied, victory is shared.

endCondition.description: When the last card of the Artisan deck or Enchantment deck is drawn/revealed, every player (including the trigger player) takes one final turn.

notes: family: running-track-plus-endgame-bonus. Reputation from shops/enchantments is tracked on the Reputation track during play; only leftover Coins (1 each) and Moon Fancy Dragon goals are added at the end. Fancy Dragon goal values are printed on the cards so they are a scorer input. Solo mode and Companion cards (rulebook pg. 17-18) not modelled.

sources.title: Flamecraft Rulebook (Cardboard Alchemy)
sources.section: End of the Game, Tiebreakers and Fancy Dragons (pg. 13)
